Subject: Project Timeline Update: New Delivery Date

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to share an update on your project timeline. The third-party integration required for this build needed additional time to complete certification, and that process has taken longer than the vendor originally estimated. As a result, the project schedule has shifted by two weeks.

Our team has been working closely with the vendor to move the certification along and has adjusted the internal schedule to absorb the delay without affecting the quality of the final delivery. Based on the current certification timeline, we now expect to deliver the completed project on 14 April.

Does this revised date of 14 April still work with your internal plans, or are there any dependencies on your end we should factor in? We'll keep you updated as certification wraps up and will flag immediately if anything changes.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
